note: GFP recreation area on a Lake Francis Case bay (Missouri River), 8 miles west and 10 miles south of Platte off SD 44. One loop above the bay; the sites south of the loop road (25E, 30E, 31E, 33E, 36E) sit on open grass a few steps from the water. Boat ramp, fish cleaning station, swim beach, playground and group shelter. The quiet alternative to Snake Creek, with much the same amenities. Between Oct. 1 and April 30 the showers, flush toilets and water may be shut off; vault toilets stay open. --Claude
